title: APM / 서비스 맵
description: span 관계(ParentSpanId → SpanId)로 그린 서비스 간 호출 그래프. 노드 테두리는 에러 비율이고, 아래 서비스 목록 표에서 서비스명을 클릭하면 상세 대시보드로 이동한다. 헬스체크·Swagger 요청은 제외했다

panels.title: 서비스 호출 그래프 — 노드는 받은 요청(SpanKind=Server), 엣지는 서비스 경계를 넘은 호출
panels.description: 노드가 하나만 보이면 상대 서비스에 OTel Agent가 붙지 않았거나 그 서비스가 이 시간 범위에서 요청을 받지 않은 것이다. 엣지가 없으면 서비스 간 호출 자체가 없었거나 traceparent가 전파되지 않은 것이다

targets.rawSql: SELECT ServiceName AS id, ServiceName AS title, toString(count()) AS mainstat, round(avg(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS secondarystat, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() AS arc__error, 1 - countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() AS arc__success FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanKind = 'Server' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /actuator%' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /swagger%' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /v3/api-docs%' AND Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY ServiceName

SELECT concat(p.ServiceName, ' → ', c.ServiceName) AS id, p.ServiceName AS source, c.ServiceName AS target, toString(count()) AS mainstat, round(avg(c.Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS secondarystat FROM otel.otel_traces AS c INNER JOIN otel.otel_traces AS p ON c.TraceId = p.TraceId AND c.ParentSpanId = p.SpanId WHERE c.SpanKind = 'Server' AND c.SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /actuator%' AND c.SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /swagger%' AND c.SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /v3/api-docs%' AND c.Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND c.Timestamp <= $__toTime AND c.ServiceName != p.ServiceName AND p.Timestamp >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE AND p.Timestamp <= $__toTime AND p.ServiceName IN (SELECT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanKind = 'Server' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /actuator%' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /swagger%' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /v3/api-docs%' AND Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime) GROUP BY source, target

panels.title: 서비스 목록 — 서비스명을 클릭하면 상세 대시보드로 이동
panels.description: span 실측 기반이다. 메트릭 기반인 'HTTP 성능' 대시보드와 숫자가 다를 수 있다 (그쪽 p95는 히스토그램 버킷 상한 근사)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ServiceName, count() AS requests, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() AS error_rate, round(quantileExact(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms, round(avg(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS avg_ms FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanKind = 'Server' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /actuator%' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /swagger%' AND SpanName NOT LIKE 'GET /v3/api-docs%' AND Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY requests DESC
